Read: o occupies (rel.occupies) a carrier c2 (st.travel_region) with st.lane_enters(c2, j) for the intersection j the subject approaches, c2 governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign, a yield sign or a traffic signal showing flashing_red. dev.governs 'Not a stand-in for: a position' does not apply: governance is read. The role 'driver' is read through o's controlled motion, never as membership."},{"span":"s2","atoms":["kin.speed","rel.contact","prim.closest_approach_within","prim.closest_approach_distance","rel.occupies","st.intersection"],"derived":["drv.motion.complete_halt"],"justification":"'having so yielded' requires the act itself, with its qualifications: o yielded right-of-way 'to vehicles on such through highway in obedience to' the device at its entrance (DEF-NRS-484A-275). Read over o's approach, from the last observation at which o's occupancy of c2 rose until its occupancy of j rose: where c2 is governed by a stop sign or flashing-red signal, o came to rest on c2 short of j (drv.motion.complete_halt, 'complete cessation from movement'); and o did not proceed (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) while a vehicle on the through highway was in a danger of a crash with it, the right-of-way bound operationalized on s9 (prim.closest_approach_within / prim.closest_approach_distance with p.conflict_horizon and p.conflict_centre_clearance), nor touched one (rel.contact). The primitives' exclusion 'alone establishes none of [contact, clearance, danger]' is respected: the danger is the operationalization's bound. Subsection (A) itself is not in this plan nor accepted, so its words are carried by these observables, not by composition."},{"span":"s5","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicles' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; ru.aggregate: 'membership of a legal aggregate: the atom's literal argument is an aggregate id'. Its exclusion 'a relational role such as who drives or controls a vehicle — never membership' does not apply: 'the drivers of' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion (agency reading), and the aggregate only states the class. 'all other' = every vehicle other than the one about to enter: the subject is never the same road user as o."},{"span":"s6","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.lane_enters","st.travel_region","st.intersection"],"derived":[],"justification":"st.lane_enters: 'a road user's approach to an intersection is a carrier it occupies (rel.occupies) whose entrance end is that intersection ... approaches through it whatever its motion'. {"node_id":"LVMC_11_18_020","law_refs":["LVMC-11-18-020"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"k1","text":"The City Traffic Engineer is authorized to mark and maintain with yellow paint or road buttons crosswalks approximately twelve feet in width at intersections in the vicinity of schools where in the opinion of the City Traffic Engineer crossing the roadway by schoolchildren is unsafe.","role":"condition"},{"id":"k2","text":"The City Traffic Engineer, if necessary, is further authorized to mark and maintain with a distinguishing color or road buttons upon the pavement or by signs erected along the curb in a conspicuous manner, the words \"School-Xing,\" not less than one hundred feet in advance of each crosswalk established","role":"condition"},{"id":"k3","text":"and","role":"boilerplate"},{"id":"k4","text":"it shall be unlawful for the operator of any vehicle to drive into a crosswalk","role":"obligation"},{"id":"k5","text":"where there is displayed a sign with the words \"School-Xing,\"","role":"condition"},{"id":"k6","text":"when there is in the crosswalk","role":"condition"},{"id":"k7","text":"upon the side of the roadway on which said vehicle is coming","role":"condition"},{"id":"k8","text":"any person","role":"condition"},{"id":"k9","text":"attempting to cross the street","role":"condition"}],"elements":[{"span":"k4","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle","rel.occupies","st.crosswalk"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'the operator of' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion (agency), never as membership. With L = prim.region_lateral_offset(subject, cl) ('the signed lateral offset ... of a structure region from a road user', left positive) and y the lateral component of rel.bearing(subject, o) ('direction of b from a in a's frame'), o is on the subject's side where L > 0 and y < L, or L < 0 and y > L. {"node_id":"LVMC_11_18_020","law_refs":["LVMC-11-18-020"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"k1","text":"The City Traffic Engineer is authorized to mark and maintain with yellow paint or road buttons crosswalks approximately twelve feet in width at intersections in the vicinity of schools where in the opinion of the City Traffic Engineer crossing the roadway by schoolchildren is unsafe.","role":"condition"},{"id":"k2","text":"The City Traffic Engineer, if necessary, is further authorized to mark and maintain with a distinguishing color or road buttons upon the pavement or by signs erected along the curb in a conspicuous manner, the words \"School-Xing,\" not less than one hundred feet in advance of each crosswalk established","role":"condition"},{"id":"k3","text":"and","role":"boilerplate"},{"id":"k4","text":"it shall be unlawful for the operator of any vehicle to drive into a crosswalk","role":"obligation"},{"id":"k5","text":"where there is displayed a sign with the words \"School-Xing,\"","role":"condition"},{"id":"k6","text":"when there is in the crosswalk","role":"condition"},{"id":"k7","text":"upon the side of the roadway on which said vehicle is coming","role":"condition"},{"id":"k8","text":"any person","role":"condition"},{"id":"k9","text":"attempting to cross the street","role":"condition"}],"elements":[{"span":"k4","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle","rel.occupies","st.crosswalk"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'the operator of' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion (agency), never as membership. With L = prim.region_lateral_offset(subject, cl) ('the signed lateral offset ... of a structure region from a road user', left positive) and y the lateral component of rel.bearing(subject, o) ('direction of b from a in a's frame'), o is on the subject's side where L > 0 and y < L, or L < 0 and y > L. its exclusion 'a person on a bicycle or scooter' is why the riders are named beside it), or a person riding a bicycle (ru.bicycle), an electric bicycle (ru.electric_bicycle) or an electric scooter (ru.electric_scooter) across it."},{"span":"k9","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.crosswalk"],"derived":[],"justification":"'attempting to cross' is a purpose, read through the conduct it explains: the person's presence in the crosswalk (rel.occupies(o, cw), st.crosswalk), which lies across the street."}],"operationalizations":[],"assumptions":[],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[{"span":"k1","why":"an authority given to the City Traffic Engineer to mark school crosswalks; the duty's own words read the sign displayed (k5), whoever placed it and at whatever set-back, so the duty is the same whether or not these words are read","scope":"none"}],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}],"applicability":"The subject, a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle), occupies a carrier c (st.travel_region) with st.lane_enters(c, j) for an intersection j; # Plan — batch 01 (iteration 001)

Eleven nodes and one concept record (`drv.motion.complete_halt`). No law-local aggregates (`aggregates.jsonl` is empty). Two nodes have gaps and will not be coded: `LVMC_11_16_030` and `LVMC_11_16_090_A_o2`.

Shared decisions:
- **Right-of-way.** Every yield duty (`LVMC_11_12_070_B`, `LVMC_11_20_060_o2`, `LVMC_11_20_060_o3`) uses one operationalization of DEF-NRS-484A-210's "danger of a crash unless one grants precedence". The subject must not proceed (speed above `p.halt_speed_tolerance`) while the constant-velocity closest approach of centres to the other road user falls below `p.conflict_centre_clearance` within `p.conflict_horizon`. It must also never touch that road user (`rel.contact`). All three nodes propose these parameters with identical conventions.
  - Reverse if: a label shows a yield violated where the subject slowed but did not stop. That would mean a deceleration bound is needed rather than a halt.
- **"Driver" / "operator" / "person".** These are read through the vehicle's controlled motion (`observable_reading`, category `agency`). The class is the admitted aggregate `DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle`.
  - LVMC-11-16-030, 11-16-040 and 11-16-060 do not use the word "vehicle". For those, the subject's class comes from the driver definition's own words ("drives ... a vehicle"), and for 060 from the fact that a speed limit binds the vehicle travelling there. The validator accepted this id for those laws.
  - Reverse if: the selection role rules that a speed limit with no "vehicle" in its words binds every road user.
- **Prima facie limits** (030, 040, 060) are read as maximums. This is disclosed as a narrowing on the obligation span, because the rebuttal is not modelled.

## LVMC_11_12_070_B
- **Duty.** The through-highway vehicle (subject) yields to the vehicle entering from a stop- or yield-controlled entrance.
- **"Through highway"** (DEF-NRS-484A-275) is read through the devices on the road (`status`). The entering carrier is governed by a stop sign, a yield sign or a flashing-red signal (read as the "other official traffic-control device"). The subject's own carrier is governed by none of these. An all-way stop is therefore not a through highway (branch_1).
- **"Said driver having so yielded"** refers to an act stated in subsection (A). `LVMC_11_12_070_A` is neither accepted nor in this plan, so the validator rejected a composition. The referent is carried in full as the act itself, over o's approach, from the rise of its occupancy of c2 to its entry into j:
  - o halts (`drv.motion.complete_halt`) where a stop sign or flashing red governs c2; and
  - o never proceeds while in a crash-danger conflict with a through vehicle, nor touches one.
  - The weaker fact (o merely entered from a stop approach) would change the verdict. branch_2 (no halt) and branch_3 (o pulled out into the subject's conflict bound) show this: both are not_applicable.
- **"May proceed"** is a permission to the entering driver. It is a scope-`none` residue.
- **"About to enter"** is read as o entering j within `p.conflict_horizon`, or already crossing j (`intention` reading).
- Reverse if: (A) is accepted with a yield duty whose contract differs (for example, no halt at a yield sign). Its record should then be composed `as: compliance` together with the act read here.

## LVMC_11_16_030 (gap — not coded)
- **The structure mirrors 040.** Traversing `st.railway_crossing` above the literal fifteen mph is checked when, in the 100 ft `.path` window before entry, the view fell short.
- **Exceptions.** A flagger or railroad flagger, or a railway signal or gate that governs the subject's carrier at the crossing and shows dark lights with the gate up or absent (`status` readings).
- **Gap.** The view "for a distance of four hundred feet in both directions along such railway" has no atom. `st.sight_along_way` measures along a public way and `st.sight_distance` along the road. The gap is `st.sight_along_railway`.
- **Residue.** "Of a steam, electric or any other motor railway" excludes no railway, so it is a scope-`none` residue.
- Reverse if: the operator declares that `st.sight_along_way` admits a railway as its way.

## LVMC_11_16_040
- **Obligation.** Speed at most fifteen mph while occupying intersection j.
- **Condition.** It applies when, at some observation in the 100 ft `.path` window behind entry to j, any of these held:
  - `st.sight_distance` was below the body-to-j distance (view of the intersection);
  - `st.sight_along_way` along some way the intersection lies on was below 100 ft; or
  - some traffic-aggregate member on such a way within 100 ft of j was not `rel.visible`.
- **Exceptions.**
  - "Through street": same device reading as 070-B, taken on the carrier occupied at entry.
  - "Traffic-controlled intersection": a non-dark signal, a stop sign or a yield sign governs j or a carrier entering it.
  - The second exception covers almost all of the first. Both are kept because the words state both.
- **Residue.** "Or street or highway" is a scope-`none` residue, since every intersection joins highways.
- Reverse if: a label treats a stop-sign-controlled minor approach as not "traffic-controlled". Then d10 should be narrowed to signals.

## LVMC_11_16_060
- **Obligation.** Speed at most twenty-five mph on any highway region (`st.highway`). Streets plus highways cover all of them, so no city-limit assumption is needed.
- **Exception.** A speed-limit sign of kind maximum, structure_maximum or zone governs a travel region the subject occupies. "As set forth in this Title" names no specific rule, so it is read as the posting's status (sign presence) and not composed.
- Reverse if: the corpus gains a specific posting rule the words should compose.

## LVMC_11_16_090_A_o1 (surrogate)
- **Why surrogate.** "Speed contest or exhibition of power or speed" is a conduct category defined by purpose and is the whole duty.
- **Operationalization.** It reads each named factor:
  - exhibition of power: acceleration ≥ `p.exhibition_accel_min`;
  - exhibition of speed: speed ≥ `p.exhibition_speed_min`;
  - contest: another motor vehicle side by side in the same direction, both accelerating ≥ `p.contest_accel_min` throughout `p.contest_window`.
- **Disclosed limits.** Burnouts and sliding are not read.
- Reverse if: labelled exhibitions consist mainly of yaw-dominated manoeuvres. A yaw-rate factor would then be needed.

## LVMC_11_16_090_A_o2 (gap — not coded)
- **Duty.** "Aid or abet" another's contest is conduct, but no atom records it. Proximity (`rel.centre_distance`) is not assistance, and `dev.human_direction` roles do not include starting a race.
- **Gap.** `rel.contest_assistance`.
- **The other party's contest** reuses o1's surrogate operationalization and parameters.

## LVMC_11_18_020
- **Authority sentences.** The two sentences authorizing the City Traffic Engineer impose nothing on road users. They are scope-`none` residues, because the duty selects the crosswalk by the displayed sign.
- **Duty.** The subject must not drive into (occupancy rising) crosswalk cw when all of the following hold:
  - cw marks the entrance of the carrier the subject occupies (`st.entrance_of`);
  - a `dev.zone_sign` of kind school_crossing governs that carrier;
  - a person is in cw — a pedestrian, or a rider of a bicycle, e-bicycle or e-scooter. The riders are added because "any person" is wider than `ru.pedestrian`'s contract.
- **"On the side of the roadway on which said vehicle is coming."** Using `prim.region_lateral_offset` to the centre line and the lateral bearing to the person, the person counts when on the subject's side of the centre line. On a one-way roadway, the whole crosswalk counts.
- **"Attempting to cross"** is read as presence in the crosswalk (`purpose`).
- Reverse if: labels count a person on the far half as the subject's side on narrow two-lane streets.

## LVMC_11_20_060_o1 (rule 4c)
- **Event.** The subject begins to occupy a sidewalk s while occupying a driveway/alley entrance or an alley. A building's vehicle access counts as a driveway under DEF-NRS-484A-190 ("every way or place in private ownership and used for vehicular travel"). This applies within `asm.business_or_residence_district`.
- **Act and place.** `drv.motion.complete_halt` within `p.stop_point_tolerance` of s, outside it.
- **"Stop".** The definition is DEF-NRS-484A-255, by its own scope "when required". DEF-NRS-484A-260 is "when prohibited".
- **Search.** It runs back over the unbroken run in the stop zone and ends at the last observation outside the zone upstream, or at a previous entry onto s. A history_boundary scenario is planned.
- **Spans.** "Immediately prior to" is cut into the obligation span, so the trigger is carried as its words say.
- Reverse if: labels accept a halt farther up the driveway as "immediately prior".

## LVMC_11_20_060_o2
- **Duty.** While on the sidewalk, coming from or going to a driveway or alley, the subject yields to every pedestrian-aggregate member. This uses the shared right-of-way bound, which also operationalizes "as may be necessary to avoid collision".

content.text:
The plan for all 8 laws is written and the harness validator accepts every node and the one new concept. It produces 11 nodes; 9 can go to coding, and 2 carry an atom gap that keeps their laws blocked:

- **LVMC-11-16-030 (rail crossings) is blocked.** No atom measures how far a driver can see along a railway. The existing sight atoms measure along a public road, so I filed a gap proposing `st.sight_along_railway`.
- **LVMC-11-16-090(A), the "aid or abet" half, is blocked.** No atom records someone helping another person's speed contest. I filed a gap proposing `rel.contest_assistance`.

**Nodes that can be coded:**
- **LVMC-11-12-070(B):** the driver on the through highway yields to a vehicle entering from a stop- or yield-controlled approach. "Through highway" is read from the signs on the road.
- **LVMC-11-16-040:** 15 mph through an intersection when the view was blocked during the last 100 ft of the approach. It does not apply on through streets or at controlled intersections.
- **LVMC-11-16-060:** 25 mph unless a speed-limit sign governs where the vehicle is.
- **LVMC-11-16-090(A), "engage in":** marked surrogate, because a speed contest is defined by purpose. It is tested through hard acceleration, very high speed, or two vehicles accelerating hard side by side.
- **LVMC-11-18-020:** don't drive into a "School-Xing" crosswalk while a person is in it on your side of the centre line. The two sentences authorising the City Traffic Engineer impose nothing on drivers, so they are recorded as carrying no condition.
- **LVMC-11-20-060, split into three duties:**
  - stop just before driving onto the sidewalk from a driveway or alley;
  - yield to pedestrians while crossing the sidewalk;
  - yield to vehicles when emerging onto the roadway.

  The first is checked by searching back from the moment the vehicle reaches the sidewalk, and the plan includes the extra test case for a recording that starts too late to tell.
- **LVMC-11-22-010 (full attention):** marked surrogate, because attention is a state of mind. It is tested as no collision and no dangerously short time-to-collision with the vehicle ahead in the lane.

**Choices you may want to check:**
1. **070(B) depends on subsection (A), which isn't available.** (A) is neither accepted nor in this batch, so the validator rejected composing it. I read "having so yielded" directly from the entering vehicle's conduct: it halted where a stop sign governs its approach, and it never pulled into the danger zone of a through vehicle. Once (A) is planned, check that its yield duty matches this.
2. **Three laws don't say "vehicle".** I classed the subject of LVMC-11-16-030, 11-16-040 and 11-16-060 as a vehicle anyway, from the definition of "driver" and from what a speed limit governs. The validator accepted it, but it is a reading.
3. **Prima facie limits are read as hard maximums.** Any speed above the limit is reported as a violation; the rebuttal a court may allow is not modelled.
